I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this channel, which he's a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note that evening said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Neither the channel nor any shared file gives a street address or site code for Southgate. I didn't find any shared Tansley account files, so I suggested he ask Priyanka if he needs the full address.
